steps.en: Get an API key at firecrawl.dev and install the SDK
steps.zh: 在 firecrawl.dev 拿 API key，装上 SDK

steps.en: Ask for a page as Markdown (crawl, map and search work the same way)
steps.zh: 请求某个页面的 Markdown（crawl、map、search 用法相同）

steps.en: Queues the job and picks an engine: plain fetch, or a headless browser that runs the page's JS
steps.zh: 把任务放进队列，选抓取引擎：普通请求，或先跑完 JS 的无头浏览器

steps.en: On the cloud, routes through rotating proxies and its anti-bot engine when a site blocks
steps.zh: 在云版上，遇到拦截就走轮换代理和它的反爬引擎

steps.en: Converts the rendered page to clean Markdown with its metadata and returns it
steps.zh: 把渲染后的页面转成干净的 Markdown，连同元数据一起返回

component.zh: Go 版 HTML 转 Markdown

value.en: LLM-ready page text from JS-heavy or blocking sites without running browsers, proxies or crawl queues yourself
value.zh: JS 重或会拦截的网站也能拿到可直接喂给大模型的正文，不用自己跑浏览器、代理和爬取队列

sources: https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl README.md — Quick Start (sign up at firecrawl.dev for an API key); SDKs > Python (pip install firecrawl-py; app.scrape("https://firecrawl.dev", formats=["markdown"]); app.crawl; app.search); Why Firecrawl (rotating proxies, JS-blocked content)
https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl SELF_HOST.md and docker-compose.yaml — API + workers, playwright-service, Redis, RabbitMQ, NuQ PostgreSQL; bundled Playwright with basic fetch fallback
https://docs.firecrawl.dev/contributing/self-host — self-hosted feature support table (Fire-engine and advanced anti-bot not included; screenshots/actions require Fire-engine)

https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl apps/api/src/lib/html-to-markdown.ts — Go converter via koffi shared library or HTTP service, postProcessMarkdown from @mendable/firecrawl-rs; apps/ — go-html-to-md-service, playwright-service-ts, api
